errors.text_span: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of article generation types
errors.evidence: The chart's central title is "Task Type", and the two categories are "Article generation" and "Headline generation". Describing the chart's purpose as only concerning "article generation types" is an inaccurate oversimplification.

errors.text_span: The chart displays a total of three slices, representing three different categories of article generation.
errors.evidence: The donut chart clearly shows only two slices/categories: "Article generation" and "Headline generation".

errors.text_span: The largest slice, colored red, is labeled “Agency A”
errors.evidence: The largest, reddish slice is labeled "Article generation (83.2%)". "Agency A" is part of the figure's caption in the source material, not a label on the chart itself.

errors.text_span: A smaller, yellow slice labeled “Task Type”
errors.evidence: The smaller, yellow slice is labeled "Headline generation (16.8%)". "Task Type" is the text in the center of the donut chart, not the label for a slice.

errors.text_span: The chart includes percentage labels inside each slice
errors.evidence: The percentage labels are located outside of the donut chart slices, next to their corresponding category labels.
